title: Unauthenticated HTTP discovery registry permits arbitrary broker endpoint publication and removal
evidence_summary: Unauthenticated PUT returned 200 and published tcp://127.0.0.1:61666; victim DiscoveryTransport consumed it; unauthenticated DELETE returned 200 and removed it.

title: OpenWire RemoveSubscriptionInfo can delete durable subscription queues without SecurityStore authorization
evidence_summary: Control core delete was denied for missing DELETE_DURABLE_QUEUE; OpenWire unsubscribe deleted victimClient.retainedOrders anyway; final JUnit run passed.

title: Axis latest/default candidate
evidence_summary: Default branch latest commit predates 2026, so this new-project false-positive audit did not spend PoC-agent budget on Axis.

title: FTP and SFTP consumers trust remote listing names for read, delete, and rename paths
evidence_summary: Workspace receipt recorded POC_VERDICT=CONFIRMED: malicious listing name a/../../../secret.txt led to RETR and DELE poll/a/../../../secret.txt and server-normalized access to /secret.txt; outer agent exceeded token budget before normal final message.

title: ADD IDENTITY authorizes global role creation instead of target-role control
evidence_summary: Non-superuser with only CREATE ON ALL ROLES bound an mTLS identity to an unrelated non-superuser role; MutualTlsAuthenticator authenticated that identity as the victim role; clean JUnit run passed.
